subject.title: Feature Request: Disable exec command credential masking / secret replacement

question: Should OpenClaw expose any bypass for forced exec/tool credential redaction, and if so what boundary should constrain it?
rationale: Current code and docs treat this as an intentional safety boundary, while the requested config option would weaken credential protection and the reported pre-shell mutation is not proven from current source.

options.title: Design a narrow trusted path
options.body: Add only a maintainer-approved privileged, local-only, ephemeral raw-payload or SecretRef-style workflow that is excluded from persistence and UI/event surfaces.

options.title: Keep boundary unchanged
options.body: Close or defer bypass requests and document safer ways to pass secrets through environment, SecretRef, files, or purpose-built credential helpers.

options.title: Allow a broad config opt-out
options.body: Add a persistent global or per-agent switch such as credentialGuard=false, accepting that existing redaction safety surfaces can emit raw credentials.

recommendation.title: Design a narrow trusted path
recommendation.body: Add only a maintainer-approved privileged, local-only, ephemeral raw-payload or SecretRef-style workflow that is excluded from persistence and UI/event surfaces.

likelyOwner.reason: He provided the clearest prior maintainer signal for this exact raw-payload redaction safety boundary.
